decision_cruda.rationale: LH-01 is down at C590-09 (16.5 g/t, 260 t). Radio and CMMS agree, and the likely repair is 13:20. Central is already truck-limited: loader inflow is 110 t/h against 91 t/h of truck capacity, and the stockpile is 297 of 450 t. The other Central stopes hold 849 t of broken ore, so trucks can't haul everything already available through 17:00. An extra loader at C590-09 would only add stockpile, not hauled ounces. It would also take a loader from a producing place or from DS-E569-02 (5.7 oz/h). LH-08 on the infrastructure heading is cheap at 0.4 oz/h, but a loan there gains about 0 oz. LH-10 comes out of PM at 10:00 but would hit the same truck limit. No stope is stopped, so no reserve can be activated. No loans.
